title: New request, Edit request
purpose: Record a specimen request as it was received, or change a draft or returned one.
summary: Record a specimen request as it was received, or change a draft or returned one.

tasks.title: Record a request
steps: Type the [[Title]], choose the [[Investigator]] and how it was [[Received by]], and type the [[Purpose]].
Select [[Create request]]. Edit lines opens next.

tasks.title: Change a draft or returned request
steps: Change the fields, give the [[Reason for the change]] and select [[Save changes]].

good_to_know: Each allocated specimen's consent must permit every use requested.
Leaving all studies unticked allows material of any study.
The ethics approval date is shown, not checked.
Never enter participant names, signatures or contact details.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators; viewers are refused. Editing is possible only while the request is a draft or returned for changes; otherwise the form says why and nothing can be saved. A manager reopens an approved request to change it. It opens in the form dialog over the page you came from; without JavaScript it is a page of its own. Cancel returns without saving.
Creating a request takes you to Edit lines to add what is requested. Editing returns to the request.

items.label: Title
items.description: Required, up to 160 characters. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Investigator
items.description: Required. The requesting investigator from the distribution catalogues (active ones, plus the current one when editing). The request takes the investigator's institution; it cannot change to another institution while a linked agreement is with the current one.

items.label: Received by
items.description: Required: email, letter, request form, meeting or other.

items.label: Purpose
items.description: Required, up to 4,000 characters: the research use as the requester stated it. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Uses requested
items.description: Scope categories that govern use (only those marked Governs use). Each allocated specimen's consent must permit every category chosen. At least one is needed to submit.

items.label: Studies
items.description: Optional. Leave all unticked for material of any study; ticked studies limit which specimens can be allocated.

items.label: Data requested
items.description: Optional, up to 4,000 characters. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Ethics approval reference, Ethics approval valid until
items.description: Optional: the requester's approval. The date is shown on the request; it is not checked.

items.label: Reason for the change
items.description: Required when editing, kept in the request's timeline. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Create request records a draft numbered RQ-000001 and up. Save changes records the change with its reason; the lines stay as they are. If someone changed the record after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay in the form and the next save uses the current version.
